title: Design tokens
description: <design>/tokens.json, the single source of the visual system (scripts/CONTRACTS.md 6.2). List-shaped so it mirrors Claude Design's Design System format (a DTCG name-to-value map cannot be read there, FD15-F28). Token names match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}; every token has a non-empty usage. tokens.mjs generates the CSS custom properties, the Tailwind @theme mirror and DESIGN.md from this file; nothing else is edited by hand.

families.description: At most two families plus a monospace with a role (ARCHITECTURE.md P4); display and body may be the same family, mono may be null.

family.description: A role of type.families (display, body, mono) or a family name listed in type.fonts.

direction.description: The direction picked at H1, by id and name.

sources.description: Pattern-ledger ids, research findings or files the values come from.

usage.description: Where and why the token is used; never empty. v1.1 (2026-10), colour tokens: the usage also declares the token's contrast pairs, which tokens.contrast reads (there is no pairs field): the token names after on, over or against, joined by commas, and, or, or a slash ('secondary text, 4.5:1 or more on bg'); names also pair (on-<x> on <x>, <x>-foreground on <x>, foreground on background). The words before 'on' set the kind: large text 3:1, text 4.5:1, a UI part (border, ring, focus, icon, input, chart) 3:1, a surface a 1.1:1 step in dark themes only, decoration none, anything else text. An explicit ratio may raise the minimum, never lower it. A text or UI colour naming no ground, or a ground name matching no token, fails the gate.

value.description: CSS colour per theme id of color.themes.

token.description: A spacing, radius, shadow or motion token. The value is a CSS value, or one CSS value per theme id; extra keys (for example easing on a motion token) are allowed.

font.description: A self-hosted font file. Licences accepted by ip.fonts: OFL, Apache, UFL or MIT, with the licence file shipped (ARCHITECTURE.md P4).

weight.description: A weight (400) or a variable range ("100 900").

source.description: Where the file came from (for example google/fonts ofl/<family> at a commit).

repoPath.description: Repository-relative POSIX path: no leading slash, no drive letter, no backslash, no '..' segment.
